∀ (A : Type u_1) [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] (M₁ : Type u_2) (M₂ : Type u_3) (M : Type u_4) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} M₁]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} A M₁] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} M₂] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} A M₂]
  [inst_5 : AddCommGroup.{u_4} M] [inst_6 : Module.{u_1, u_4} A M] (P₁ : Type u_5) (P₂ : Type u_6)
  [inst_7 : AddCommGroup.{u_5} P₁] [inst_8 : Module.{u_1, u_5} A P₁] [inst_9 : AddCommGroup.{u_6} P₂]
  [inst_10 : Module.{u_1, u_6} A P₂] [Module.Projective.{u_1, u_5} A P₁] [Module.Projective.{u_1, u_6} A P₂]
  (ι : LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) M₁ M)
  (π : LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_4, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) M M₂),
  Function.Injective.{u_2 + 1, u_4 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_4 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_4 + 1} ι) →
    Function.Surjective.{u_4 + 1, u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1), u_4 + 1, u_3 + 1} π) →
      Eq.{u_4 + 1} (LinearMap.range.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_4} ι) (LinearMap.ker.{u_1, u_1, u_4, u_3} π) →
        ∀ (f₁ : LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_5, u_2} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) P₁ M₁)
          (f₂ : LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_6, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) P₂ M₂),
          Exists.{max (max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1)) (u_6 + 1)} fun f =>
            And
              (Eq.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1)}
                (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_5, max u_5 u_6, u_4} f (LinearMap.inl.{u_1, u_5, u_6} A P₁ P₂))
                (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_5, u_2, u_4} ι f₁))
              (Eq.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_6 + 1)}
                (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_6, u_4, u_3} π
                  (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_6, max u_5 u_6, u_4} f (LinearMap.inr.{u_1, u_5, u_6} A P₁ P₂)))
                f₂)
